setting.label: Definitions
setting.help: Shown once a card is open. Quizzes stay in Chinese. In English only, words without an English definition still show Chinese; the 中 button on a card shows it for that card. English definitions come from an open dictionary and are a reference only. Me → Chinese definitions can hide them until tapped.

phrases.label: Phrases
phrases.help: Learn page only: phrases open or stay folded once a card is open. Review and learned-word pages keep them folded. Saved on this device only.
